data.title: Price increase for mobile tariff "Muster Allnet 10 GB"
data.summary: Muster Mobil GmbH informs Mara Beispiel that the monthly base price of her "Muster Allnet 10 GB" tariff rises from €19.99 to €22.99, effective 1 February 2026, giving her a special right to cancel.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly price of your plan. All other services stay the same. Because this change is not only in your favor, you have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) free of charge within a window the app will show you, counted from when you received this letter; if you cancel in time, the contract ends at the earliest when the new price takes effect. If you do nothing, the higher price applies automatically from the effective date. Review whether the new price still suits you and act by the deadline shown if you want to switch providers.
